probes.query: Where does the tool persist its conversion results to disk between runs so that unchanged files are skipped on the next build?
expectedFacts: There is no on-disk incremental build cache; every run re-creates the TypeScript program and reconverts all entry points.

The cacheBust option only appends a ?cache=<render start time> query to asset URLs in generated HTML; it is not a build cache.
